#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

NEW=$(openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 32)
OLD=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "{{secret_name}}" --query SecretString --output text)

echo "rotating {{secret_name}}"
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value \
  --secret-id "{{secret_name}}" \
  --secret-string "$NEW" \
  --version-stages AWSPENDING

kubectl set env deployment/{{service_name}} APP_SECRET="$NEW" --record
kubectl rollout status deployment/{{service_name}} --timeout=120s

aws secretsmanager update-secret-version-stage \
  --secret-id "{{secret_name}}" \
  --version-stage AWSCURRENT \
  --move-to-version-id "$(aws secretsmanager describe-secret --secret-id {{secret_name}} --query 'VersionIdsToStages | to_entries[?contains(value, `AWSPENDING`)].key | [0]' --output text)"

echo "rotation done"
